newsitem.title: UK: UK's Standard Life plans new banking service - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK's Standard Life plans new banking service - paper.

text.p: British mutual life assurance company Standard Life is expected to announce plans for a new banking operation this week, according to the Sunday Telegraph newspaper.
The new banking operation will offer products and services such as a savings facility, personal loans and mortgages, the paper said.
The new services and products will be marketed through independent financial advisers from which Standard Life already gets its investment and insurance business, the paper added.
Standard Life introduced a deposit account last October with the underlying banking carried out by the Bank of Scotland.
It is not believed the new operations will require an extension of this service and Standard Life has not ruled out applying for its own banking licence in the future, the Sunday Telegraph said.
Representatives of Standard Life were not available for comment.
